title: Comprehensible Input Log
user: A language self-learner using books, podcasts, and videos who needs to choose material near their level and see whether input is becoming understandable without a gamified course.
smallest_useful_product: An offline log where users save a source, duration/pages, self-rate understanding, record up to three recurring unknown words, and get a trend view plus a simple next-source target.
constraints: Self-ratings are subjective and must not be presented as proficiency scores; no copyrighted media is uploaded; local export/import is required.
